rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant structural damage and injury caused by another vehicle; clear-cut auto claim with both comprehensive vehicle damage and injury components.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle (trunk crushed into back seat) and injuries including whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver information is documented in the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled - entire trunk crushed into back seat
